prediction.model: LightGBM on physics features + Sightglass rationale engine
prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 52.6 °C (70% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 58.8 °C (51% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 57.3 °C (59% above healthy). Rapid temperature accumulation with minimal inlet-outlet drop indicates loss of cooling circulation.
Valve: severe lag. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.94 s (within 1% of healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.57 s (3% above healthy). Transient response is severely sluggish, preventing timely transition of working pressure.
Pump leakage: no leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.56 l/min (within 1% of healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 361 W·min/l (6% below healthy). Flow delivery and motor electrical consumption match expected volumetric efficiency without leakage.
Accumulator: severely reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 45.7 bar (within 2% of healthy). Pressure buffering is largely ineffective due to compromised pre-charge pressure in the accumulator.
